label: Protocol spec
claim: Bounded schema vocabulary, signed examples and negative schema/profile cases are covered. Full OpenAPI semantics remain UNVERIFIED.

evidence.title: static schema vocabulary cannot silently expand beyond the bounded validator
every inline signed worked example verifies and enrollment never carries its seed
semantic schema and profile failures do not authorize signed attacker payloads

label: Protocol core (`lib/protocol`)
claim: Unit-test coverage for canonical JSON, domain-separated Ed25519 signatures, request proofs, rosters, invites and independently retained job/attempt identity binding.

evidence.title: golden fixed TEST-ONLY keys, fingerprints and every signed byte
key and signature encodings reject noncanonical and invalid curve material
roster creation, root/circle pins, temporal boundaries and anti-rollback
invite link, context-bound enrollment and expiry
request exact bytes, clock boundaries and atomic nonce callback order
synchronous request proof shares validation and rejects asynchronous nonce callbacks
identity predicates bind independently retained job and attempt

label: Coordinator store and HTTP server
claim: Signed job lifecycle, lease fencing, historical-roster membership checks and forged-proof rejection are covered hermetically. This is not live hosting evidence.

evidence.title: v1 happy path preserves signed inputs, renewal, result and original acknowledgement
v1 lease expiry before the agent started reclaims the job, increments generation and permanently fences old completion
v1 historical roster HTTP reads require current membership and return the exact epoch
v1 JSON forged proofs and oversized signed lengths fail before the body arrives

label: Client, CLI, MCP
claim: Hermetic circle enrollment and the five original annotated job tools are covered. The MCP surface also exposes registry operations; it is no longer described as exactly five tools in total.

evidence.title: circle create, invite, join, approve advances signed roster and enrolls only invited device
stdio MCP initializes, keeps the five annotated job tools, and completes verified job journey

label: Developer CLI and results as branches
claim: Apply creates a new local branch and commit while preserving the current branch, index and uncommitted work. This does not prove GitHub publication or live sandbox code-change results.

evidence.title: apply creates a new branch at the base with a commit built from the prompt and receipt
apply accepts the short job ID that run and job print
apply never touches the current branch, index or uncommitted work

label: Diff results
claim: Injected-backend tests cover archive diffs and pinned Git trees; the Changes API returns a bounded diff and file list. Real sandbox code-change execution remains UNVERIFIED.

evidence.title: archive job: the lender returns a signed diff against the committed snapshot, with diffstat and base tree
pinned git job: the filtered tree retains the verified commit without claiming a diff base
Changes tab data: file list, bounded unified diff and the apply command for a diff candidate

label: Joining and circles
claim: Signed invite enrollment is covered by CLI tests. A browser test covers creating, renaming and selecting two circles on one host, including an old-member compatibility refusal. Real-device joining remains UNVERIFIED.

evidence.title: circle create, invite, join, approve advances signed roster and enrolls only invited device
start, rename and use two circles on one host in every selector
a legacy member is named before a rename, and updating lets the owner save

label: Short invites
claim: Publication, public resolution, expiry and binding rejection have automated coverage. A dishonest queue landing page can still capture its fragment seed; real desktop activation and OS handlers remain UNVERIFIED.

evidence.title: a published invite resolves publicly to exactly its public envelope and binding
resolve answers 404 for unknown or malformed codes and 410 once the invite has expired
publication refuses a binding the invite key did not make and malformed bodies

label: Lender loop
claim: The existing lender suite covers reservations, restart reconciliation and job control with injected execution. It is not proof of real sandbox cessation.

evidence.title: M8 restart retains the reservation until cessation is verified and then reconciles

label: Local app and web UI
claim: One-time local handoff and evidence-bound safety facts have API coverage. Browser coverage is named separately for circles; this is not a blanket sign-in, platform or screen pass.

evidence.title: local handoff expires at 60 seconds and is consumed exactly once
handoff redirects once to a clean route with a cookie that authenticates the web app
missing or invalid safety inputs stay unknown rather than becoming promises

label: Desktop app
claim: The macOS supervisor is covered with injected boundaries and Linux-compatible process tests: launch, duplicate reuse and tray ownership. Real Finder, LaunchServices, launchd, installers and Windows execution remain UNVERIFIED.

evidence.title: first interactive launch starts the app, opens the one-time handoff (never the token URL) and owns the tray
a duplicate launch reuses the running one: it opens a handoff for it, starts nothing and signals nobody

closed budget fields reject provider window/account details and invalid effort

label: Transcript scrubbing and relay
claim: Tests preserve safe transcript lines, withhold oversized media, normalize local project paths and keep known lender values out of signed handoffs. Relay availability distinguishes older hosts; no claim of universal secret detection is made.

label: Trust and safety controls
claim: Frozen audiences, audit-write failure, atomic refusal of limit changes and responsive pause/stop during a hung mutation have regression coverage. These do not prove the sandbox boundary on every platform.

evidence.title: freeze audience refuses an old host before uploading prompt or source
an audit write failure cannot enable automatic lending
a refused combined limits and mode save leaves every limit unchanged
pause, skip and stop answer while a network mutation hangs
